summary: Design-only acceptance/contract for Research OS Migration Phase 2, automation/acceptance/research-os-migration.yaml: a controlled, history-preserving relocation of the Research OS governance layer (dashboard, registries, acceptance contracts, receipts, reviews, automation) from wifi-csi-fall-attack-safety-demo (remote https://github.com/shahram-h-hesari/wifi-csi-fall-attack-safety-demo.git, branch feature/safety-proxy-guided-defense, starting commit ed50db0d62b755cd7aae9f00228665ba0cdb5750) into research-os (remote https://github.com/shahram-h-hesari/research-os.git, base branch main, base commit b997ed6aba4e3395c3b02eef951b3536450b8961), building on the now-ACCEPTED Migration Phase 1 (EXTERNAL-REPO-RESOLUTION-design 9/9, EXTERNAL-REPO-RESOLUTION 52/52). Defines: (1) an inspected migration inventory beyond the three prompted paths -- RESEARCH_DASHBOARD.md, automation/ (entire directory), scripts/automation/ (entire directory) EXCEPT test_split_guard.py and test_split_guard_cases.py (explicit, reasoned exception: the .claude PreToolUse hook that invokes test_split_guard.py protects the EXPERIMENT repository's own git/shell operations and would silently stop firing there if the script moved; the AUT-TSG governance record migrates as history, the live enforcement script does not), plus the relevant single .gitignore line and .claude/skills/dashboard-refresh/SKILL.md; additional dependency checks performed and logged for requirements.txt (PyYAML gap noted, not introduced by this design), .claude/skills/git-stage-check/SKILL.md (experiment-repo-specific, excluded), EXPERIMENT_EVIDENCE_INDEX.md/LOCAL_PROJECT_MAP.md/README.md/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md/LICENSE (all excluded), and script import/execution dependencies (none found outside automation/ and scripts/automation/ beyond stdlib/PyYAML/pytest); (2) an exclusion inventory (results/, figures/, checkpoints/model weights, scripts/analysis/, scripts/archive/, dataset/training code, experiment execution scripts, thesis-specific files, the test-split-guard exception, git-stage-check skill, gitignored pilot logs); (3) a chosen history-preservation method -- git subtree split per migrated directory + git format-patch/git am for standalone root files, merged via --allow-unrelated-histories onto a new migrate/research-os-layer branch branched from research-os main at the exact base commit, never main directly -- with explicit justification (safest for this repository's clean two-directory-plus-root-files shape vs. a full filter-repo pass), explicit treatment of root-file preservation, unrelated-file/commit exclusion (mechanical via subtree-split prefix scoping), original-commit-identity handling (subtree split rewrites SHAs; originals remain reachable in the source repo; migration receipts record the mapping), authorship/timestamp preservation (both mechanisms preserve original author metadata by design), duplicate/unrelated-history avoidance, and why no force-push or history rewrite is required (all operations occur on new, unpushed-until-ready branches); (4) a dedicated migrate/research-os-layer target branch policy (never main directly, never force-push, mandatory remote/commit identity verification before any write, mandatory dirty-worktree hard-stop beyond explicitly named pre-existing untracked items, source branch untouched during import); (5) post-migration external-repository configuration -- the tracked registry entry for repository_id wifi-csi-fall-attack-safety-demo (portable fields only), the real local override's required properties (gitignored, no credentials, created only during the implementation's validation phase, never during this design step), and a four-part implementation test plan (real-checkout resolution test, synthetic dirty-worktree re-run, legacy bare-path compatibility test, negative sibling-folder-inference-rejection test); (6) a receipt and historical-task policy distinguishing accepted-historical tasks (no reconciliation needed) from reverified cross-repository tasks (DASH-D3, TOOL-REXP, REG-EXPERIMENT-ID, REG-CANDIDATES/NEXT-EXP-REVIEW/DASH-NEXT-EXP-REVIEW, AUT-TSG-impl as a special historical-only case), with reconciliation receipts created only on a genuine count/outcome discrepancy, never as a matter of course; (7) a five-phase implementation plan (import -> configure/validate cross-repo resolution -> verify -> establish authority -> a SEPARATE, later, separately-gated source-decommission task explicitly out of scope for this contract and its future implementation); (8) an authority-transition definition naming the exact point research-os becomes authoritative (after phase 4 merge + full validation-suite pass + a human approval receipt for the implementation claim itself) and what changes before/after that point, including that VALIDATION-PILOT-GATE may resume only in research-os post-transition and that the test-split-guard exception continues operating from the experiment repository indefinitely, never frozen; (9) a 20-point implementation validation suite covering remote/commit identity, inventory/exclusion verification, zero-evidence-copy proof, byte-identical file/receipt-hash verification, approval-binding continuity, full test-suite pass from research-os, resolver/Result-Explorer/artifact-scanning correctness and read-only-ness, dashboard idempotency, registry/validator/Brainstorm-Checker/candidate-review parity, unweakened test-split guards, unchanged experiment queue, source-repository operational continuity throughout, zero copied result data, zero committed absolute machine-specific paths, and proven rollback via simple unmerged-branch deletion. YAML re-parsed successfully via yaml.safe_load (24 top-level keys). No migration branch was created in research-os; no file was copied, moved, or deleted in either repository; no remote was changed; no history was merged; no git subtree/filter-repo/format-patch/cherry-pick/bundle command was run; no real local override file was created; VALIDATION-PILOT-GATE implementation was not started; no experiment, queue action, protocol change, or held-out-test read occurred. automation/registry/, automation/reviews/, automation/experiment_queue.yaml, automation/frontier.yaml, automation/literature/, all protocol-freeze records, all test-split-guard files, and scripts/automation/ (other than this contract's own tasks.yaml/changelog edits) remain byte-unchanged, confirmed via git diff --stat showing zero output against the full protected-file list.
